analysis:
Examined the startup preload changes in ProviderLoop+StartupPreload.swift. At head line 243, canLoadMore now calls startupPreloadCanLoadMore (head lines 313-315). That function adds a watchdog stop flag, startupPreloadStopRequested, ahead of the existing slot-cap check. markStartupPreloadReached (head lines 321-322) now stamps startupPreloadCandidate and transitionGenerations.begin(.startupPreload). finishStartupPreload resets both new fields (head lines 306-307).

In ProviderLoop.swift, the patch changes autopilotHistory to a named tuple with an added detail field. It also adds in-memory state: autopilotAdoptedModelIDs, autopilotHolds, autopilotBusyClock, transitionWatchdog, autopilotStalledCommandId, the preload stop and candidate fields, resliceGateGeneration and transitionGenerations (head lines 342-380).

These are availability and lifecycle supervision changes. The stop flag only makes the preload do less: it halts before the next candidate and never resumes a skipped load. Fail-closed self-test retirement, advertisedModels filtering, failedSelfTestHashes and isRefusedByRetirement are unchanged. No change touches encryption (T-008), attestation or authorization (TB-009, TB-011, T-052, T-053), the prefix cache (T-041), or plaintext handling.

One consideration was whether a watchdog stop after registration could leave a self-test-failed model advertised. Retirement runs inline within each candidate step, and a stop only prevents later candidates. Models that were not preloaded fall back to the lazy-load path, as before the change. I found no regression in this batch.

Open integration questions:
- How superviseTransitions and TransitionWatchdog set startupPreloadStopRequested and cancel autopilot commands; their source is not supplied.
- Whether a cancelled ('transition_stalled') autopilot operation could leave a model loaded and advertised without an authorization or placement lease.
- Whether autopilotHistory's new detail field is sent to the coordinator or telemetry with sensitive content (T-058 diagnostics exposure).
- That the autopilotAdoptedModelIDs and autopilotHolds semantics in ProviderLoop+AutopilotPlacement, which is not supplied, do not bypass the superseded-build or retirement refusal.
